title: Prompt with no Stop (user interrupt) leaves its task open forever and its evidence out of the episode record
observation: 1.38 host close only runs on the Stop hook. A prompt that ends without Stop (user interrupt / re-prompt) keeps state=open; the next prompt continues it but never closes it, and taskRecordFromReports skips open members ('Members still open contribute nothing yet'), so that prompt's deliveries/checks never reach the episode's graph record. Observed 2026-09-16 on the live ledger: htask_1685696b ('do it', 4 lessons delivered) stayed open while its successors 8d7840f9/57c168d1/54537aed closed; htask_dc6c0e21 (episode head, re-prompted 19s later) stayed open; record .hunch/tasks/htask_c1ae87379a520e5ca8b313ad.json holds only the head's 2 lessons + 54537aed's save, none of 1685696b's 4 lessons. Candidate fix: in startHookReport, when continuationLinks finds a still-open previous task with no pending check, host-close it (completed or interrupted) before starting the new one, then persist the episode record.
evidence: node dump of .hunch-cache/served.db report_tasks since 2026-09-15: all other continued prompts closed by=host; 1685696b open (cont=8f5cb0a8 ep=c1ae8737, delivery@13:02:06), dc6c0e21 open (next prompt d82b19ec at +19s)
